newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGA SHIPYARD 96 PROFIT 1.2 MLN LATS - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: RIGA SHIPYARD 96 PROFIT 1.2 MLN LATS - REPORT.

text.p: Riga Shipyard, expected to enter the bourse soon after this week's eight percent share sell-off for cash, said its unaudited 1996 profit was 1.2 million lats, Diena newspaper reported on Monday.
Riga Shipyard saw 12 million lats net cash turnover in 1996, an increase of 30 percent against 1995, the company's board chairman Eriks Kazha was quoted by Diena as saying.
It is expected to grow by some 20 percent this year, Kazha was quoted as adding.
Subscription begins this week for 8.37 percent or 837,140 of the company's shares which will be auctioned on April 14.
The Latvian Privatisation Agency has set the minimum price of these shares at 1.30 lats.
